text: To close a period all periods it depends on must be closed, including prior and child periods. For example to close a year the prior year must be closed and all quarters in the year must be closed, and for each quarter to be closed all months within the quarter must be closed. In other words when closing periods start with months, then close quarters once all months in the quarter are closed, then close a year once all quarters in the year are closed. Periods may be closed one at a time using the **Close Period** button on the *Accounts* tab of the *Accounting* => *Time Period* screen.  For convenience a period and all prior and child periods can be closed all at once using the **Close Period + Depends** button.
